purpose: Define a replaceable trust boundary for a genuinely external monotonic provider without claiming that TPM/HSM/remote-service infrastructure exists.
requirements: Provider binding MUST identify provider_id, durability_domain_id, installation_id and runtime_id.
Provider durability_domain_id MUST differ from the consumer local durability domain before externality is accepted by the adapter.
Receipts MUST advance exactly one sequence, bind previous receipt hash and payload hash, and pass provider verification.
Provider read_floor MUST be at least the accepted receipt sequence; a floor behind a receipt is fail-closed rollback evidence.
The adapter MUST NOT claim that a real external provider, protected production key, HSM, TPM, remote service, multi-host lease or physical independence has been established.
Provider maintenance and receipt verification are zero Experience and zero operational progress.
No formal MISSION_STATE mutation or live routing authority is granted.
